observations: Kāśikā uses an afterlife belief pair. Lack of thought and having a negative thought have different entailments.
A nipāta analysis and an expressly licensed finite or clausal quote are both transmitted.
The Bhāṣya puts iti next to the three quoted contents and drops it from the suffix input.
Kāśikā describes a view guided by epistemic evidence. Padamañjarī interprets the evidence as tradition about fate.
Tattva and Mallinātha expressly use diṣṭa in the fate sense. Tattva disputes the older direct pramāṇa gloss.
Mallinātha names 4.4.60 ṭhak and analyses the abstract from daiṣṭika.
The 1933 item OCR and the Mallinātha digital edition support the daiṣṭika lexical address.
The GRETIL-based verse has naiṣṭhikatām. The paired display keeps the contrary Mallinātha analysis in its own text.
Food-habit forms include both the repeated activity and the relevant object.
Three Bhāṣāvṛtti examples extend the named habit list. Vācaspatyam names karuṇā.
The Bhāgavata line gives a joined instance of kāruṇikasya before idam.
The pupil example has competing protective-relation accounts with the recorded false overextensions.
The gaṇa mentions sthā with prefix qualification. Quote variants and broader effective lists need separate word support.
Bhāṣāvṛtti names the study, austerity and habitual-theft cases together with the pupil word.
Habitual kārma and ordinary aṇ kārmaṇa have separate final -an policies.
The 6.4.172 interpretation provides the aṇ-conditioned feminine behavior for habitual ṇa.
The 4.1.15 supplement directly attests two long forms. The Bhāṣāvṛtti digital display has short yāṣṭikī.
Bhāṣāvṛtti supplies pāśika as another 4.4.57 head.
Doubled school noun chāttra is independently supported and fits the optional doubling context.
decisions: Construct the affirmative and contrary negative opinion words under the specific meaning. Mere possession or absence of thought fails.
Preserve both quoted nipāta and special finite syntax at the same output.
Keep the three daiṣṭika interpretation histories independent. They yield the same ordinary segmental cases.
Derive the feminine abstract daiṣṭikatā and attach the witnessed ACCsg to it.
Recognize the actual daiṣṭika and naiṣṭhika presentations. Leave the latter's precise sense and their common ancestor Open.
Give the food terms their habitual action meaning, separate from offers for sale and materials presented in a rite.
Construct the three further named habit heads with an exact free genitive witness for the compassion word.
Keep teacher protection and pupil protection as legitimate explanations. The literal carrier or servant does not satisfy this student use.
The bare sthā teaching label has prefixed nominal eligibility only. Preserve the named roster and the broader Nyāsa scope for the next stage.
Admit study, austerity, theft and habitual-work stems by named production.
Kārma has the scoped 6.4.172 outcome. Preserve the frozen distinct aṇ kārmaṇa.
Admit the directly cited two feminine ṇa constructions under the reported inference.
Admit the directly cited long śāktīkī and yāṣṭīkī. Keep short feminine yāṣṭikī as a scoped source observation with exact print and derivation Open.
Admit pāśika on the explicit Bhāṣāvṛtti 4.4.57 address.
Count the doubled spelling as a reading with an independent history at each case of the one student fibre.
